details:
Abandoned but Not Forgotten: Storytelling About NASA's Discarded Equipment on the Moon and Mars

Project Overview:

Abandoned but Not Forgotten is an interactive educational website designed to help young learners explore the spacecraft, rovers, landers and scientific instruments left behind on the Moon and Mars. The website uses two fictional young explorers, Anaya and Kabir, who guide children through an exciting space exploration journey using storytelling and character narration.

How It Works:

The website provides four interactive chapters through which users can explore different space artifacts. Each artifact includes images and educational information explaining its purpose and contribution to space exploration. Users can navigate between chapters, listen to character introductions and storytelling narration, view artifact images in full size and enjoy background music.

Benefits and Intended Impact:

The project makes space science easier and more enjoyable for children. It transforms complex scientific information into simple, interactive learning content. It aims to develop curiosity, improve awareness of historical space missions and inspire young learners to explore science, technology and space research.

Technologies Used:

- HTML – Website structure and content.

- CSS – Visual design, animations and responsive interface.

- JavaScript – Interactive features and navigation.

- Speech Synthesis API – Character voice narration.

- HTML Audio – Background music.

- Local Image Storage – Character and space artifact images.

Creativity and Innovation:

The creative aspect of this project is its storytelling approach. Instead of presenting space artifacts as ordinary scientific information, the website introduces them through two young explorers, Anaya and Kabir. The combination of character narration, interactive chapters, visual exploration and background music creates an engaging learning experience for children.

Factors Considered:

- Child-friendly design and simple navigation.

- Easy-to-understand educational information.

- Accessibility through a web browser.

- Interactive and engaging learning experience.

- Accurate representation of historical space artifacts.

- Use of images and audio to improve understanding.

Overall Impact:

Our project aims to remind young generations that even when space missions end, the equipment they leave behind continues to tell important stories about human curiosity, scientific discovery and exploration. It encourages children to look beyond Earth and become the next generation of space explorers.
